title: When Models Know but Can't Linearly Say: Relational Encoding Limits Linear Vulnerability Classification in Code LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can detect vulnerable code, yet the form of vulnerability encoding in their representations remains unclear. We analyze 8 code models spanning 6.7B-15B parameters on C programs using three datasets (DELTASECOMMITS, SVEN, and PRECISE-BUGS), comparing two diagnostic tasks on the same representations: identifying what patterns the code instantiates, and determining whether it is vulnerable. Models encode the first with high fidelity. Under the studied paired C-code datasets and linear-probing setup, vulnerability information is more accessible as a paired relational signal-whether code A is riskier than code B-than as a globally separable categorical label. This structural difference has implications for classification: the model reliably ranks which code is riskier but standard classifiers on isolated samples achieve limited accuracy because vulnerable and secure samples form overlapping distributions in representat

translated_title: 当模型知道却无法线性表达：关系编码限制了代码大语言模型中的线性漏洞分类
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够检测存在漏洞的代码，但其表示中漏洞编码的具体形式仍不清楚。我们在三个数据集（DELTASECOMMITS、SVEN 和 PRECISE-BUGS）上分析了 8 个参数量在 6.7B-15B 之间的代码模型（针对 C 程序），并在相同的模型表示上比较了两个诊断任务：识别代码实例化了什么模式，以及判断代码是否存在漏洞。模型对前者的编码具有很高的保真度。在所研究的成对 C 代码数据集和线性探测设置下，漏洞信息作为成对关系信号（即代码 A 是否比代码 B 更危险）比作为全局可分的类别标签更容易被读取。这一结构性差异对分类任务具有重要影响：模型能够可靠地对哪段代码更危险进行排序，但针对孤立样本的标准分类器却只能达到有限的准确率，因为存在漏洞的样本与安全样本在表示空间中形成了相互重叠的分布。
tldr: 该研究发现代码大语言模型将漏洞信息以“成对关系信号”（哪段代码更危险）而非全局可分的绝对标签形式编码，这解释了为什么基于孤立样本的线性分类器准确率有限。
en_tdlr: This study finds that code LLMs encode vulnerability as a paired relational signal (which code is riskier) rather than a globally separable categorical label, explaining why linear classifiers on isolated samples achieve limited accuracy.
